launches.title: Selfin: protect the risk no one else covers
launches.tagline: We find the liquidity for risks insurance and futures don’t cover
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We are [Paula](https://www.ycombinator.com/founders/paula-gutierrez) and [Joel](https://www.ycombinator.com/founders/joel-tomas-pimentel), co-founders of [Selfin](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/selfin).

**TL;DR**

We find the liquidity for risks insurance and futures don’t cover, and create an event contract with the best market makers, on Kalshi, Polymarket or OTC.

**The problem ❌**

Insurers won’t cover most of the events that can wipe out a quarter, and there’s no futures contract to hedge them with. A JFK closure stops an airline’s New York flying for the day. Falling GPU rental prices hit an AI cloud’s revenue. Relegation cuts a football club’s income overnight. Today, companies just carry that risk.

**The solution ✅**

1. **Name the event:** tell us the event that hits your revenue.
2. **We find the liquidity:** we create an event contract with the best market makers. You get protection at a price, for risk that has no futures market and no insurance policy.
3. **The multiple goes up:** reduce P&L volatility and increase the valuation of your business.

**The team 🚀**

We met at Imperial in the UK, then did our master’s theses at MIT and Stanford.

Paula: Aerospace Engineering at Imperial & MIT, previously at NASA and Bank of America

Joel: Aerospace Engineering at Imperial & Stanford, previously at BCG

**Our ask 💬**

Do you know a CFO or owner whose company is exposed to one big event? We’d love an intro.

Book a demo at [selfin.app](http://selfin.app) or email [contact@selfin.app](mailto:contact@selfin.app)
